About

I learned to sell before I learned the job title.

Theresa

In 2017 I started selling hair extensions. Nobody handed me leads. I found customers, messaged them, listened to what they needed, recommended the right product, managed the orders and delivered to people in different countries.

That is prospecting, discovery, objection handling and follow-up, done long before I knew those words. Later I moved into technology sales and added structure: CRM discipline, ICP-led research, BANT qualification and outreach sequences.

My selling comes from doing the work. I know what it feels like when a lead goes quiet, and I know what brings it back.

Client accounts · HubSpot workflow and SOP documentation

Making the handoff from closed deal to onboarding automatic.

Purpose

When a deal closes, the customer should not wait while someone remembers what happens next.

Closed wonTicket and ownerWelcome emailKickoff task

Sample builds · Follow-up and campaign organisation

Keeping follow-ups and campaigns organised across brands.

Purpose

Short projects to show how I keep follow-ups, campaign tasks and daily checks from slipping.

What I did

  • Built a Trello sales board that moves a lead from New Lead through Contacted, Follow-Up Due and Follow-Up Sent to Meeting Booked.

Three working systems I can set up for a new team. These are sample builds, so they show how I organise the work and carry no performance claims.

ProAssistNG · Sales Development Representative · Aug–Oct 2026 · B2B SaaS

Building the sales structure behind a growing SaaS business.

Purpose

The company needed an organised sales development process, clear visibility of prospects and one place to manage the pipeline.

What I did

  • Set up HubSpot CRM from scratch and customised the sales pipeline.
  • Organised lead tracking and prospect records, and connected email outreach to the workflow.
  • Wrote the company's first sales playbook: prospecting, outreach sequencing, objection handling and closing.
  • Sourced and qualified leads through email and LinkedIn outbound.

Result

60+ leads generated and 80+ follow-ups completed in one month. The team went from no CRM to a working pipeline, a documented playbook and a repeatable follow-up process.
